checks.name: source_is_report_html
checks.message: Source HTML must be the report, not an auth/login page.

checks.name: two_col_blocks_preserved
checks.message: Every source .two-col block should map to either one rendered multi-column block or preserved native text blocks.

checks.name: svg_blocks_preserved
checks.message: Every source SVG visual outside a portable chart summary should map to one rendered DOCX image.

checks.name: bar_chart_blocks_preserved
checks.message: Every source bar-chart block should map to one rendered DOCX image or native table fallback.

checks.name: portable_metric_cards_preserved
checks.message: Every portable fallback metric card should map to one native DOCX metric cell.

checks.name: portable_chart_summaries_preserved
checks.message: Every portable fallback chart summary should map to one labeled chart-data table.

checks.name: portable_chart_data_is_labeled
checks.message: Portable chart-data representations must retain a label, header, and data row.

checks.name: native_table_width_cap
checks.message: Native table column widths do not exceed the report text column.

checks.name: docx_images_have_explicit_sizes
checks.message: DOCX image entries carry explicit text-width object sizes.

checks.name: docx_image_count_matches_manifest
checks.message: Every rendered image has the metadata needed for one DOCX image.
